description: Default commands for the personal PowerShell GUI Command Builder by Thomas Schueler. Personal side project, built on personal time with personal equipment. No employer resources.

Files and folders.description: List, copy, move, and inspect files

List a folder.sentence: I want the contents of {path}, recurse {Recurse}, hidden {Force}

Copy an item.sentence: I want to copy {path} to {destination}, recurse {Recurse}

Remove an item.sentence: I want to remove {path}, recurse {Recurse}, force {Force}

Create a folder.sentence: I want a new folder at {path}

Search file content.sentence: I want lines in {path} that match {pattern}

Show permissions.sentence: I want the access list of {path}

Stop a process by id.sentence: I want to stop process {id}, force {Force}

Stop processes by name.sentence: I want to stop processes {names}, force {Force}

Start a program.sentence: I want to start {path} with arguments {arguments}

Wait for a process.sentence: I want to wait up to {seconds} seconds for {name}

Start a service.sentence: I want to start the {name} service

Stop a service.sentence: I want to stop the {name} service, force {Force}

Restart a service.sentence: I want to restart the {name} service

Set service startup.sentence: I want the {name} service to start as {startup}

Networking.description: Addresses, names, firewall, shares, and mapped drives

Map New Drive.sentence: I want to map drive {driveLetter}: to {uncPath}, keep it {Persist}, note {description}

List network adapters.sentence: I want the network adapters on this computer

Show TCP connections.sentence: I want TCP connections in state {state}

Add a firewall rule.sentence: I want a firewall rule {name} for {direction} {action} {protocol} port {port}

List SMB shares.sentence: I want the SMB shares on this computer

Disks and storage.description: Disks, volumes, and the recycle bin

List disks.sentence: I want the disks on this computer

List physical disks.sentence: I want the physical disks on this computer

Empty the recycle bin.sentence: I want to empty the recycle bin on {letter}, force {Force}

Scan a volume.sentence: I want to scan drive {letter}, online scan {Scan}

Create a local user.sentence: I want a local user {name} with password {password}, never expires {PasswordNeverExpires}

Enable a local user.sentence: I want to enable local user {name}

Write a registry value.sentence: I want to set {path} value {name} to {value}

Remove a registry value.sentence: I want to remove value {name} from {path}
